questions.prompt: What helped Anna forget to feel scared?
questions.evidenceText: Anna found a book about sharks on the shelf. She sat down and read and read. She forgot to feel scared.

questions.prompt: What did the dentist use to check James's teeth?
questions.evidenceText: "Open wide!" said the dentist. She used a small mirror and a bright little light. "All done! Ten out of ten!" James grinned.

questions.prompt: What did James learn about the check-up?
questions.evidenceText: James came out. "It did not hurt at all!" he said. "And the chair goes UP and DOWN!" Anna laughed.
